rule.threshold: largest observed benign validation probability with empirical count(p<threshold)/n <= budget
rule.prediction: p(benign)>=threshold => benign; otherwise highest-probability non-benign label
rule.arithmetic: NumPy float64 softmax, same boundary in validation and test
rule.evidence_scope: Post-hoc fixed-rule cross-run assessment. Existing test results were previously inspected; not independent confirmatory evidence.
rule.training: No retraining. Reload saved checkpoints only to recover validation logits; saved test logits unchanged.
